premises.text: Finding last-minute personal services requires dialing many merchants who may not answer or be free
premises.evidence_span: I jump on Yelp and end up dialing 20 massage therapists, mainly getting no responses or otherwise hearing that they're booked for the evening

premises.text: Many qualified local businesses will bend over backwards to fill idle time with a new paying customer
premises.evidence_span: there's a pool of highly qualified small businesses that are willing to bend over backwards in order to bring a new customer through the door

premises.text: Bidzee lets customers request a service, set terms and name a price; matching merchants accept and the card is charged and calendars updated
premises.evidence_span: Within a few clicks on a website or mobile apps, you can easily place a request for personal service, and you can even name your own price

premises.text: Merchants face no upfront cost, get bottom-of-funnel card-backed demand, timing certainty, and only accept when they have excess capacity
premises.evidence_span: A merchant working with BidZ faces no upfront investment at all

premises.text: Marketplace flips listings: customer offers themselves and Bidzee knocks on many local doors at once
premises.evidence_span: We are the only platform that flips the equation and allows a customer to offer themselves to a business versus the traditional process of asking customers to filter through various business listings

premises.text: Only verified, rated local businesses perform services, unlike consumer-to-consumer task marketplaces
premises.evidence_span: BidZ is only connecting you with a verified, rated local business in order to perform the service

value.text: Customers get appointments on their terms while businesses monetize otherwise idle time
value.evidence_span: A customer gets an appointment on their terms, and a business gets a paying customer through the door, allowing them to monetize, otherwise, idle time

causal_links.evidence_span: painful process of dialing all of those merchants just to find one that was willing to take my money
get the service that I desperately need
put extra money in the pocket of this merchant

notes: Groupon revenue cited as market evidence for merchant demand for acquisition channels, not Bidzee traction. Service category list folded into marketplace premise (v1.3.2 #5).
